limitations: All recommended actions are draft and based solely on the single saved CEMS snapshot (snapshot id: cems-emsr927-snapshot).
The CEMS activation is still open; AOIs, products, and statistics may be updated after this snapshot was taken (activation status: open).
One AOI product (Bharatpur / AOI 4) is listed as waiting for data in the snapshot; no finished GRA layers or stats are available for that AOI in this snapshot.

CEMS-provided impact statistics (built-up area, identified buildings, population, roads, max_extent) are snapshot summaries and are labelled at activation level; the underlying methods and uncertainty bounds are not included in the snapshot.
Population and 'affected' building counts in the products are estimates derived from automated mapping and should be ground-truthed before operational use.

Imagery acquisition times in the snapshot vary (acquisitions shown on 2026-08-27 and 2026-08-28); there is a temporal gap between the reported event time (2026-08-25) and imagery acquisition that may omit immediate post-event changes or later developments.
Some AOI products are monitoring-type or multi-date (AOI 3 includes monitoring layers) while others are single-product outputs; consistency across AOIs is not guaranteed.
No ground-validated damage classification is provided in the snapshot; observed-event layers and 'affected' tags are derived from imagery interpretation and may miss partial or interior damage.
Cloud cover, shadows, and small-scale debris may affect feature detection in the VHR imagery; the snapshot does not include quality metrics for each image.
Transportation layers indicate features (bridges, roads) but do not by themselves confirm passability or current obstruction status; field checks are required to confirm accessibility.
Geolocation and mapping accuracy (horizontal error) for individual features are not provided in the snapshot; local GPS verification may be required for precise field tasking.
AOI extents in the snapshot bound the analysed areas but may not include all locally reported impacts outside those polygons.
Recommendations are not prescriptive commands; they require human review and local authority decision-making before operational deployment.
